In detail

The district with Warsaw's standing reputation, and the one where it is worth separating the reputation from the record. Praga-Północ survived the war largely intact, which is why its tenements and the Koneser distillery now draw visitors, and much of Ząbkowska is gentrified. But the police numbers have not fallen with it: reported crime went from 3,097 in 2018 to 4,013 in 2023, with 3,073 in the first eleven months of 2024, and the district has a high rate of drug offences. Detection stood at 52.1% in 2019 — roughly half. Go for the bars and the museums; the courtyards off the main streets are a different proposition at night.
